# f5xc_service_credential (Resource)

Object keeps track of various object credentials downloaded by users.

To get more information about f5xc_service_credential, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/api-credential)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Service Credential - Api Certificate

resource "f5xc_service_credential" "example" {
  name            = "example-service-credential"
  namespace       = "system"
  expiration_days = 30

  service_credential_choice = {
    api_certificate = {
      password = "ExamplePass1!"
    }
  }

  namespace_roles = [
    {
      namespace = "system"
      role      = "ves-io-monitor-role"
    }
  ]
}
```

```terraform
# Example: Service Credential - Namespace Roles

resource "f5xc_service_credential" "example" {
  name            = "example-service-credential"
  namespace       = "system"
  expiration_days = 7

  service_credential_choice = {
    api_token = true
  }

  namespace_roles = [
    {
      namespace = "system"
      role      = "ves-io-monitor-role"
    }
  ]
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `expiration_days` (Number) Expiry in days Qty of days of service credential expiration.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Name Name of API credential record. It will be saved in metadata.
- `namespace` (String) Namespace Value of namespace is always 'system'.
- `namespace_roles` (Attributes List) Roles list of roles per namespace to be assigned to service credentials. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--namespace_roles))
- `renew_trigger` (Boolean) Local Terraform trigger flag for API token renewal.
- `service_credential_choice` (Attributes) Service Credential Spec Credential specification can be one of the following types - * service api token * service api certificate * service kube config * site global kube config (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--service_credential_choice))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
- `user_group_names` (List of String) User Groups Names list of user_groups assigned to this service credential

### Read-Only

- `credential_name` (String) Actual credential name assigned by backend.

## Import

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an `import` block to import this resource by ID.

> **Note:** Replace placeholder values (for example, `<namespace>`, `<name>`) with actual values.

#### Command-Line Import

Use the following `command` to import this resource from the command line:

```shell
terraform import f5xc_service_credential.example <namespace>/<credential_name>
```

#### HCL Import Block

Use the following `hcl` block to import this resource during `plan` or `apply`:

```hcl
import {
	id = "<namespace>/<credential_name>"
	to = "f5xc_service_credential.example"
}
```
